purpose: Show broad, high-volume social proof via a masonry wall of embedded tweet-style posts, distinct from the curated few-card testimonials section used on Home.

motion.detail: CSS columns masonry, 1/2/3 columns at sm/lg; no scroll or hover motion measured beyond link-copy interaction

tweetBodies.licensing: Live site content is real tweets from real people; this clone's tweets-data.js uses placeholder text per the source code's own comment. A generator must use real, permissioned quotes or clearly-fictional placeholder copy, never attribute an invented quote to a real Twitter/X handle.
